name: Deadmines
summary: Beneath Moonbrook, the Deadmines lie silent under a ruined town in Westfall. Once the greatest gold producer in human lands, the mines were abandoned during the First War. Now rumors speak of sinister forces in the forgotten shafts, though their danger remains unknown.

sections.title: A Vein of Gold and Blood
sections.body: The Deadmines once led all human mines in gold, with Whitestone oak for timber and supports. When the orcish Horde pushed north, miners fled in haste. Sir Anduin Lothar entered the treacherous depths to recover the sacred Tome of Divinity. Subterranean ogres held him captive for twenty months before rescuers freed him. After the kingdom fell, the shafts went quiet, and people came to say they were cursed.

sections.title: VanCleef's Foundry
sections.body: After Stormwind's stonemasons rioted, the newly formed Defias Brotherhood took the Deadmines as its chief refuge. Stormwind's Miners' League tried to reopen the tunnels under Foreman Thistlenettle, but Defias brigands ambushed the workers and collapsed the shafts. The slain miners now wander as restless undead. Ogre enforcers and goblin tinkerers guard the deep tunnels, where the Defias have built an industrial war camp around a shipyard in Ironclad Cove.

faq.q: How do you get into the Deadmines?
faq.answer: Find the main entrance inside the Defias Hideout in ruined Moonbrook, in southwestern Westfall. Winding down through the basements leads into the mine shafts.

faq.q: Why were the mines abandoned in the first place?
faq.answer: The mines were abandoned during the First War, when the Horde overran the kingdom's southern regions. War raged and ogres moved into the depths, ending the mining work. The empty tunnels soon gained a reputation for being haunted.

faq.q: What is the Defias Brotherhood building down here?
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef and hired goblin engineers are building an enormous ironclad juggernaught in the flooded cavern of Ironclad Cove. VanCleef means to sail it up the coast and bombard and besiege Stormwind City in retribution.

faq.q: Who are the undead wandering near the entrance tunnels?
aliases: why are there ghouls in deadmines
faq.answer: The undead are Miners' League workers led by Foreman Thistlenettle. Defias thugs ambushed the League as it tried to survey and reclaim the mine, then collapsed the shafts. The trapped miners died and rose as restless ghouls.

faq.q: What connection does Anduin Lothar have to the Deadmines?
faq.answer: Sir Anduin Lothar journeyed deep into the Deadmines during the First War to retrieve the sacred Tome of Divinity. Ogres dwelling in the caverns captured him and held him for nearly two years before he was rescued.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can trace a holy history to the Deadmines. Sir Anduin Lothar entered their darkest chambers during the First War to recover the sacred Tome of Divinity from savage ogres.
As a miner, you walk where human mining once reached its height. Before the First War, the Deadmines led all human lands in gold production, before goblin machinery and Defias outlaws took over.
